answers.eng_dens02_0663: Good morning, everyone. My name is Li Ming. I am a Grade 7 student. Today I want to talk about using stress to show meaning. In my opinion, stress is very useful because we can stress the important words to make others understand us better. For example, in the sentence "I did not go there yesterday", I can stress "not" to show a different meaning. In a word, using stress well makes our English clearer and more expressive. Thank you for listening.
answers.eng_dens02_0666: Good morning, everyone. My name is Wang Fang. I am a Grade 7 student. Today I want to talk about reading a passage aloud and retelling its main idea. I think this is a good way to learn English. When I read a short passage aloud, I pay attention to pronunciation and pauses, and then I retell its main idea in my own words. This helps me understand and remember the text better. In a word, reading aloud and retelling make my English better. Thank you.
